Billiards in Cyprus

Looking for somewhere to play billiards in Cyprus? RackUp's directory lists 19 halls in 6 cities, each with its address and phone number. Pick a city to see its halls.

Pick a city

  • Nicosia 6 halls
  • Paphos 4 halls
  • Larnaca 3 halls
  • Limassol 3 halls
  • Paralimni 2 halls
  • Ayia Napa 1 hall

Looking for an opponent in Cyprus?

Post the hall, the game and the time on RackUp: pool (8-Ball, 9-Ball, 10-Ball), or carom (3-cushion, 1-cushion) at halls with carom tables. See who takes the table, or ask to join a table someone else opened. The feed filters by city, and every month there is a ranking by city and hall.
